### What happened

In a Cezarion task, I added and committed `packages/cezar/src/core/mock-cursor-scenario.test.ts` while Squeal was validating the worktree. Vitest includes `src/**/*.test.ts`, and the repository's pinned `npm test -- packages/cezar/src/core/mock-cursor-scenario.test.ts` runs all 23 tests successfully. At revision 9, Squeal still says this path is not a test file any runner lists. It selects a different test that reads the file instead. This prevents the new file's own background verdict from being used.

Related: hearsay-tools/squeal#142 covers the pending-discovery message for a new test file. Here the file was already committed, discovery was not reported as pending, and the path stayed classified as outside every runner while Squeal offered another file's verdict.

### What you expected

Discover a new included test file after its creation/commit. Return its own result when I name its path. If discovery is pending, report that state and its cause instead of classifying the path as not run.

### Command and output

`squeal status --json packages/cezar/src/core/mock-cursor-scenario.test.ts`

Recorded JSON excerpt (full original retained in the task evidence):

```json
{
  "revision": 9,
  "selection": {
    "outcome": "snapshot",
    "code": 3,
    "result": "none",
    "reason": "unsynced",
    "paths": [
      { "path": "packages/cezar/src/core/mock-cursor-scenario.test.ts", "kind": "not-run", "selects": 1 }
    ],
    "testFiles": [
      { "project": "server", "path": "packages/cezar/src/core/workflow-no-progress-registration-parity.test.ts", "state": "pending" }
    ]
  }
}
```

The accompanying text says: `Not run by Squeal: packages/cezar/src/core/mock-cursor-scenario.test.ts is not a test file any runner here lists; it selects the 1 test file that reads it, whose verdict is not its own`.

Earlier status probes also classified this new file as not run. No source swaps or Squeal configuration edits were used. The task branch is `cez/a95883b4` at `9ab2aaa82fceef46abeebfe85b128242fe89f4d3` in public repository `hearsay-tools/cezarion`.

### Squeal version

0.1.410, recorded with `squeal --version` at the time of the revision 9 status capture.

### Squeal revision

9

### Harness

Codex

### Model

gpt-6.1-sol-fast (Codex worker in a Cezarion campaign).

### Cost

At least three path-specific status probes and a direct Vitest run were needed. The new test file's background result remains unavailable, so the final verification must distinguish manual coverage from Squeal verdicts.

### Did a daemon restart clear it?

Not tried. Existing focused suites were running, so I did not interrupt them.

### Suggested fix

Invalidate runner discovery when a newly created test matches an active project's include pattern. Keep a new test pending until its own discovery/run finishes, and distinguish that state from a file outside all test projects.

comments.body:
More evidence from a cezarion campaign night (hearsay-tools/cezarion#2728 Phase 1), same class.

### What happened
S3 worker: `squeal status --wait 60000 src/test/agent-browser-cdp-timeout.test.ts` on a new test file returned after 65.7 s with "not a listed test file"; it selected 93 reader test files, all pending, because runner discovery waited behind an in-flight run capped at 966 s. S4 worker: two new test files stayed unlisted for more than 30 minutes after `squeal start` ("revision 2 is not listed yet"), and `squeal retry` had nothing to retry. Host load average 15-30.
### What you expected
A new test file is listed and gets its own verdict within a few minutes, or the status names the blocking run and its expected end.
### Command and output
`squeal status --wait 1000 <new tests>` → "Named test files have no verdict; revision 2 is not listed yet"; `squeal retry <new tests>` → "Not listed yet ... has nothing to retry".
### Squeal version
0.1.407
### Harness
Codex (cezar workers)
### Cost
Workers fell back to direct focused test runs; over 30 minutes without Squeal verdicts in one worktree.
### Did a daemon restart clear it?
No, it stayed after a restart.

Related evidence, hearsay-tools/cezarion, 2026-11-07, Squeal 0.1.412 (worker c40a4b3e, P1c). Newly added test files stayed unlisted. 60 s focused waits on the changed files timed out and selected 102 unrelated browser readers. The daemon reported runner discovery queued behind an in-flight call, with a 966 s bound. The worker ran an explicit focused run instead, and its final claims rest on the bundled coverage gate, not on Squeal.

title: A committed new test file stays 'not a test file any runner lists' and borrows another file's verdict
